label: Hitboxes
settings_description: Settings for the Hitboxes gameplay mod. Forces `RenderManager.debugBoundingBox`. Classified `grey` in §11.

line_width.description: GL line width used for the bounding box wireframe.

color.description: Colour of the bounding box wireframe.

show_eye_line.description: Whether to draw the vanilla eye-direction ray along with the box.

eye_line_color.description: Colour of the eye-direction ray, when `show_eye_line` draws it. Its own colour rather than the box's: the ray answers *where is he looking*, which is a different question from the box's *where is he*, and one colour for both draws a box with a spike on it rather than two readings.

max_distance.description: Furthest an entity can be, in blocks, and still be drawn. The point of a box in a fight is the entity you are fighting; every box past that is a wireframe over the scenery. 64 is vanilla's own entity render distance, so the default draws what the game was already drawing.

keybind.description: Key that toggles the mod in game, captured through `void.openKeybindCapture('hitboxes')`. Boxes are worth having for one fight and not the next, which is a decision made mid-match rather than in a menu.

state_colors.description: Whether a box changes colour with what you can do to its entity: `damaged_color` while it is in its hurt animation, `hittable_color` while your crosshair is on it within attack range, and `color` otherwise.

hittable_color.description: Box colour for the entity your crosshair is on, when `state_colors` is on.

damaged_color.description: Box colour for an entity in its hurt animation, when `state_colors` is on. Takes precedence over `hittable_color`.
